name: Daniela Reyes
text: [reaction] After an enemy attacks an investigator at your location: Fight that enemy (using either a basic fight action or a Fight ability on a card). (Limit once per round.) [elder_sign] effect: +1. Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location.
backText: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0-5, Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0-2, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Daniela's Wrench, In Harm's Way, 1 random basic weakness.
flavor: "Those creatures are definitely gonna know what hit 'em."

name: Daniela's Wrench
text: Daniela Reyes deck only. [fast] Exhaust Daniela's Wrench: Choose an enemy at your location. That enemy engages you and makes an immediate attack. [action]: Fight ([combat]). You get +2 [combat] for this attack. If this enemy attacked you this round, this attack deals +1 damage.

name: In Harm's Way
text: Revelation - Put In Harm's Way into play in your threat area. Forced - After you deal damage to an enemy: Take 1 damage and place 1 damage on In Harm's Way. If there is 3 or more damage on this card, discard it. Forced - When the game ends: Suffer 1 physical trauma.

name: Joe Diamond
text:
[reaction] After you successfully investigate: Draw 1 card. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. If you succeed, draw 1 card and gain 1 resource.
backText: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-5, Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0-2, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Detective's Intuition, Dead Ends, 1 random basic weakness.
flavor: "I can't stop now. Not when I'm so close to the truth."

name: Detective's Intuition
text:
Joe Diamond deck only.
Gain 2 resources and heal 1 damage or 1 horror.
[reaction] After you draw Detective's Intuition during your turn: Reveal it and draw 2 additional cards.
flavor: "I don't know how you do it, Mr. Diamond. Your insight never ceases to impress."

name: Dead Ends
text: Forced - When you search your deck and Dead Ends is among the searched cards: Draw it, cancel the effects of the search, and shuffle your deck. Forced - When the game ends or you are eliminated, if this card is in your hand: You earn 2 fewer experience.

name: Trish Scarborough
text:
You may take an additional action during your turn, which can only be used to evade.
[elder_sign] effect: +0. After this test resolves, you may disengage from each enemy and move to a connecting location.
backText: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0-5, Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-2, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Covert Ops, Black Chamber Operative, 1 random basic weakness.
flavor: "You're quite good, but nobody can catch me."

name: Covert Ops
text:
Trish Scarborough deck only.
[reaction] After you evade an enemy, exhaust Covert Ops: Either draw 1 card, or move to a connecting location.
flavor: There are alley cats more conspicuous than you.

name: Black Chamber Operative
text: Hunter. Prey (Trish Scarborough only). Forced - After you evade Black Chamber Operative: Place 1 of your clues on your location. If you cannot, this enemy readies, engages you, and makes an immediate attack.
flavor: "There is nowhere to run, Ms. Scarborough."

name: Dexter Drake
text: [reaction] After you play an asset: Either return another non-story asset you control to your hand, or play a different asset from your hand (paying its cost). (Limit once per round.) [elder_sign] effect: +1. You may return a non-story asset at your location to its owner's hand.
backText: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-5, Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0-2, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): "For my next trick...", The Necronomicon (Drake Translation), 1 random basic weakness.
flavor: "I'll show you real magic."

name: "For my next trick..."
text: Dexter Drake deck only. Search your deck for a [[Spell]] or [[Item]] asset and play it, reducing its cost by 2 (shuffle your deck). This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: The Necronomicon
text: Revelation - Put The Necronomicon into play in your threat area. It cannot leave play except by the [action] ability below. You cannot play assets or trigger abilities on other assets you control. [action]: Test [willpower] (5). If you succeed, discard The Necronomicon. If you fail, shuffle it into your deck and take 1 horror.

name: Isabelle Barnes
text:
[fast] During a skill test you are performing, take 1 direct horror: Commit an eligible skill from your discard pile to this test. After this test resolves, shuffle that card into your deck. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. If you succeed, heal 1 horror.
backText: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0-5, Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-2, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Isabelle's Twin .45s, Breaking Point, 1 random basic weakness.
flavor: "My sister's sacrifice won't be in vain."

name: Isabelle's Twin .45s
text: Isabelle Barnes deck only. Uses (6 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight ([combat]). You get +1 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack. [reaction] After you resolve the above ability, spend 1 ammo and exhaust Isabelle's Twin .45s: Fight ([agility]). You get +1 [agility] and deal +1 damage for this attack.

name: Breaking Point
text: Revelation - Take 1 direct damage. Then, if you have 6 or fewer remaining sanity, take 1 direct damage. Then, if you have 3 or fewer remaining sanity, take 1 direct damage.

name: Bodyguard
text:
Bodyguard may be assigned damage dealt to other investigators at your location.
[reaction] When Bodyguard is defeated: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location.
flavor: "I'm not here to help you shop; I'm here to keep you alive."

name: Endurance
text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [combat] for this skill test (+2 [combat] instead if this is an attack or evasion).
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [agility] for this skill test (+2 [agility] instead if this is an attack or evasion).

name: Logan Hastings
text:
You get +1 [combat].
[reaction] After you defeat an enemy, exhaust Logan Hastings: Gain 1 resource.
flavor: "Preparing for Armageddon seems insane until it's the end of the world!"

name: M1911
text: Uses (4 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight ([combat]). You get +1 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack.

name: Resilience
flavor: Nothing's gonna keep you down.

name: Lesson Learned
text:
Fast. Play after an enemy attacks you.
Discover 1 clue at your location.

name: Right Tool for the Job
text: Search the top 9 cards of your deck for a [[Tool]] or [[Weapon]] asset and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
flavor: "Keep digging. You'll find something you need in there."

name: Counterattack
text: Fast. Play when an enemy attacks an investigator at your location (before resolving that attack). Cancel that attack. Deal 1 damage to that enemy.

name: Bodyguard
text:
Bodyguard may be assigned damage dealt to other investigators at your location.
[reaction] When Bodyguard is defeated: Deal 2 damage to an enemy at your location.
flavor: "I'm not here to help you shop; I'm here to keep you alive."

name: Sledgehammer
text: [action]: Fight ([combat]). This attack deals + 1 damage. [action][action]: Fight ([combat]). You get +3 [combat] for this attack. If you succeed, you may exhaust Sledgehammer for this attack to deal +2 damage.
flavor: Twenty-two and a half pounds of steel vengeance.

name: Winchester Model 12
text: Uses (3 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight ([combat]). You get +3 [combat] for this attack. If you succeed, this attack deals +1 damage for each point you succeed by (to a maximum of +4). If you fail and would deal damage to another investigator, this attack deals 1 damage for each point you fail by (to a maximum of 5 damage).

name: Dorothy Simmons
text:
You get +1 [intellect].
[reaction] After you successfully investigate by exactly 1 or 3, exhaust Dorothy Simmons: Gain 1 resource.
flavor: "I've taken every class that Dr. Christopher offers!"

name: Local Map
text: Uses (4 secrets). [action] Spend 1 secret: Investigate ([intellect]). Investigate a revealed connecting location. You get +1 [intellect] for this investigation. If you succeed, you may exhaust Local Map to move to that location.
flavor: "I could swear we've been here before..."

name: Sharp Rhetoric
text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [intellect] for this skill test (+2 [intellect] instead if this is an investigation or parley).
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] for this skill test (+2 [willpower] instead if this is an investigation or parley).

name: Gather Intel
text:
Fast. Play when an enemy enters your location.
Draw 2 cards.
flavor: You learn so much more by getting up-close and personal.

name: Through the Cracks
text: Evade ([agility]). You get +1 [agility] for this evasion for each clue you control (to a maximum of +3). If you succeed, you may disengage from each enemy engaged with you and move to a revealed connecting location.

name: Mysterious Grimoire
text:
Uses (4 secrets).
[fast] During your turn, spend 1 or 2 secrets and exhaust Mysterious Grimoire: Search the top 3 cards (or 6 cards instead if you spent 2 secrets) of your deck for a card and draw it. If 1 or more weaknesses are among the searched cards, draw them as well. Shuffle your deck.

name: Through the Cracks
text: Evade ([agility]). You get +2 [agility] for this evasion for each clue you control (to a maximum of +6). If you succeed, you may disengage from each enemy engaged with you and move to a revealed connecting location.

name: Unbridled Knowledge
text: Reveal the top 5 cards of your deck (8 cards instead if you control 2 or more clues). Draw 3 of them and place the rest of those cards on the top and/or bottom of your deck in any order.

name: M1903 Hammerless
text: Uses (4 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight ([agility]). If the targeted enemy is exhausted, this attack deals +1 damage.

name: Olivier Bishop
text:
You get +1 [agility].
[fast] During your turn, exhaust Olivier Bishop: Move to a connecting location.
flavor: "I suppose I'll help you... for now."

name: Silver Tongue
text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [intellect] for this skill test (+2 [intellect] instead if this is an evasion or parley).
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [agility] for this skill test (+2 [agility] instead if this is an evasion or parley).

name: Sticky Fingers
text:
Limit 1 per investigator.
[reaction] After you successfully evade an enemy, exhaust Sticky Fingers: Gain 1 resource.
flavor: Worse than a kid in a candy shop.

name: Paint the Town Red
text: Parley. Search the top 9 cards of the encounter deck for a non-[[Elite]] enemy, draw it, and gain resources equal to that enemy's printed health. Shuffle the encounter deck.
flavor:
You can't put a price on fame.
Or can you?

name: Prestidigitation
text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Play an [[Item]] asset from your hand, reducing its cost by 2. When your turn ends, return an [[Item]] asset you control to your hand.
flavor: Now you see it. Now you don't.

name: Out of Sight
text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test is successful by 2 or more, the performing investigator may disengage from each enemy and move to a revealed connecting location.

name: Sticky Fingers
text:
Fast. Limit 1 per investigator.
[reaction] After you successfully evade an enemy, exhaust Sticky Fingers: Gain 1 resource.
flavor: Worse than a kid in a candy shop.

name: Decisive Strike
text: Fight ([combat]). You get +2 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack. If this attack defeats an enemy, gain 5 resources.
flavor: Don't forget to check the pockets.

name: Out of Sight
text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test is successful by 1 or more, the performing investigator may disengage from each enemy and move to a revealed location up to 2 connections away.

name: Cloak of Resonance
text: [reaction] When horror is placed on Cloak of Resonance, exhaust it: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location.
flavor: "To be createde of 3 partes aether, 2 cinnabar, and at least 3 pounds ophe rokket gatherede from ain hevenful mountain." -Alchemical Formula No VIII ca. 1660

name: Cosmic Flame
text: Uses (3 charges). [action]: Fight ([willpower]). If you succeed, you may spend 1 charge to deal +1 damage for this attack. If you reveal a [skull] token during this test, remove 1 charge from Cosmic Flame (if you cannot, take 1 damage and discard this card).

name: Jim Culver
text:
You get +1 [willpower].
[reaction] After you take damage and/or horror, exhaust Jim Culver: Draw 1 card.
flavor: "You see these folks too? You never really get used to them."

name: Lucky Charm
text: Uses (4 charges). [fast] Spend 1 charge and exhaust Lucky Charm: Move 1 damage or 1 horror from a card at your location to a card you control (with a health or sanity value).

name: Second Sight
text: Uses (3 charges). [action]: Investigate ([willpower]). If you succeed, you may spend 1 charge to discover 1 additional clue at your location. If you reveal a [cultist] token during this test, remove 1 charge from Second Sight (if you cannot, take 1 horror and discard this card).

name: Spiritual Intuition
text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] for this skill test (+2 [willpower] instead if this test is on a [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] card).
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [combat] for this skill test (+2 [combat] instead if this test is on a [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] card).

name: Will of the Cosmos
text: Place 1 doom on a player card you control. Then, discover 1 clue at your location and 1 clue at another revealed location.
flavor: In the cosmos, all are one. In the void, all is none.

name: Soul Link
text: As an additional cost to commit Soul Link, take 1 horror.
flavor: By the power of the ancients am I reborn anew.

name: Mask of Silenus
text:
Uses (3 charges).
[reaction] When you would reveal a chaos token, spend 1 charge: Reveal 1 additional token. Choose 1 of those tokens to resolve and ignore the other. If you resolved a token with a symbol, take 1 horror.

name: Augur of Elokoss
text: Investigate ([intellect]). Add your [willpower] to your [intellect] for this investigation. If you succeed, discover 1 additional clue at your location. If you succeed and a token with a symbol was revealed during this test, you may discard a [[Terror]] or [[Hex]] treachery from any investigator's threat area.

name: Cosmic Flame
text: Uses (4 charges). [action]: Fight ([willpower]). You get +2 [willpower] and deal +1 damage for this attack. If you succeed, you may spend 1 charge to deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location. If you reveal a [skull] token during this test, remove 1 charge from Cosmic Flame (if you cannot, take 1 damage and discard this card).

name: Aleksey Saburov
text: [reaction] When your turn begins: Heal 1 damage or 1 horror from Aleksey Saburov.
flavor: "I've had way worse, pal."

name: Hunter's Instinct
text:
Limit 1 per investigator. Uses (3 supplies). If there are no supplies on Hunter's Instinct, discard it.
[reaction] After you engage an enemy, spend 1 supply and exhaust Hunter's Instinct: Add a level 0 event in your discard pile to your hand.

name: Jumpsuit
text: [fast] During your turn, discard Jumpsuit: Choose a [[Tool]] or [[Weapon]] asset in your discard pile and add it to your hand.
flavor: You keep finding things you thought you'd lost in those deep pockets.

name: Levelheaded
text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] for this skill test (+2 [willpower] instead if this test is on a scenario card).
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [agility] for this skill test (+2 [agility] instead if this test is on a scenario card).

name: "Shove off!"
text: Evade ([agility]). If you succeed, deal 1 damage to the evaded enemy. If you fail, return "Shove off!" to your hand at the end of your turn.

name: Slippery
text: If this skill test is successful while evading a non-[[Elite]] enemy, that enemy does not ready during the next upkeep phase.

name: Timely Intervention
text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
You may commit Timely Intervention from your hand after revealing chaos tokens during a skill test you are performing.

name: Scrape By
text:
Fast. Play when you would fail a skill test during which a non-[auto_fail] token was revealed.
You succeed at that skill test by 0 instead. If a token with a symbol was revealed during that skill test, take 1 horror.

name: Old Compass
text: [action]: Investigate ([intellect]). Your location gets -1 shroud for this investigation. If you fail, you may exhaust Old Compass to attempt this test again. If you do, your location gets -2 shroud for this investigation, instead.

name: On the Brink
text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test fails, return each other card committed to this test to its owner's hand and draw 1 card.
flavor: Nobody knows what you'll do if you're pushed past your limits.

name: Meat Cleaver
text: [action]: Fight ([combat]). You get +2 [combat] for this attack (+3 [combat] instead if you have 3 or fewer remaining sanity). If this attack defeats an enemy, you may heal 1 horror. [reaction] When you trigger the above [action] ability, take 1 horror: This attack deals +1 damage.

name: Broken Bottle
text: [action]: Fight ([combat]). You get +1 [combat] for this attack. If you succeed, you may discard Broken Bottle to deal +1 damage for this attack.
flavor: It was cheap whiskey, anyway.

name: Fedora
flavor: A little style goes a long way.

name: Hand-Crank Flashlight
text: [action]: Investigate ([intellect]). You get +1 [intellect] for this test. If you succeed, you may discard Hand-Crank Flashlight for your location to get -1 shroud until the end of the round.
flavor:
Works in any situation, and the batteries never run out!
- Schoffner's Catalogue, Spring 1927 ed.

name: The Gold Bug
text: Revelation - Put The Gold Bug into play in your threat area. It cannot leave play except by the [action] ability below. You get -1 health and -1 sanity. [action]: Shuffle the Gold Bug into your deck.

name: The Nameless Lurker
text: Aloof. Spawn - Farthest empty location. Forced - When the investigation phase ends, if The Nameless Lurker is ready and has no doom on it: Place 1 doom on it.

name: Pursued
text: Revelation - Put Pursued into play in your threat area. Forced - After an enemy enters (moves into or spawns at) your location: Take 1 horror. [action][action]: Discard Pursued.

name: Syndicate Obligations
text: Revelation - Put Syndicate Obligations into play in your threat area. Forced - After you spend 1 or more resources: Take 1 damage. [action][action]: Discard Syndicate Obligations.

name: Wounded
text: Revelation - Put Wounded into play in your threat area. Forced - The first time you move each turn: Take 1 damage. [action][action]: Discard Wounded.

name: Spreading Flames
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull] -X. X is the current act number.
[tablet] -1. Reveal another token. If you fail, take 1 damage.
[elder_thing] -3. If you fail by 2 or more, draw the topmost copy of Fire! in the encounter discard pile, if able.
backText:
Hard / Expert
[skull] -X. X is 1 more than the current act number.
[tablet] -2. Reveal another token. If you fail, take 1 damage.
[elder_thing] -4. If you fail, draw the topmost copy of Fire! in the encounter discard pile, if able.

name: Past Curfew
text: [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (2). If you succeed, discard a Bystander enemy at your location.
backText: In player order, each investigator tests [willpower] (3). Each investigator who fails takes 1 horror.
flavor: The campus is strangely quiet, and there is no sign of your friend. Hooded figures cross the quad as nervous students scurry under painfully bright streetlamps.

name: Lit Up
text: [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (2). If you succeed, discard a Bystander enemy at your location.
backText:
If they are still set aside, place 4 set-aside copies of Fire! in the encounter discard pile.
In player order, each investigator tests [agility] (3). Each investigator who fails takes 1 damage.
flavor: The sky glows a faint orange as the flames spread.

name: Wild Flames
text: [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (2). If you succeed, discard a Bystander enemy at your location. Forced - After doom is placed on the agenda: The lead investigator draws the topmost copy of Fire! in the encounter discard pile.
backText: Each surviving investigator who has not resigned is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.
flavor: The campus is ablaze!

name: Where There's Smoke...
text: Objective - At the end of the round, investigators may spend the requisite clues, as a group, to advance.
backText:
Discard each enemy in play.
Put the set-aside Dormitories and Miskatonic Quad locations into play. Spawn the set-aside Servant of Flame enemy at the Dormitories.
Attach 1 set-aside copy of Fire! to Your Friend's Room. Place each other set-aside copy of Fire! in the encounter discard pile.
flavor: You are searching the dormitories for any sign of your friend.

name: Escape the Dorms
text: Objective - If each undefeated investigator is at Miskatonic Quad, advance. (Hint: Somcetimes it's better to run than to fight!)
backText: Search all in-play and all out-of-play areas for the Servant of Flame, heal all damage from them, and set them aside, out of play. Discard each enemy in play. Discard all tokens and attachments from Your Friend's Room and remove it from the game. Put each remaining set-aside location (Orne Library, Science Hall, Warren Observatory) into play.
flavor: A burning apparition stands between you and the exit. You must escape the dormitories!

name: Searching for Dr. Armitage
text: Objective - At the end of the round, investigators at Orne Library may spend the requisite clues, as a group, to advance.
backText: Put the set-aside Dr. Henry Armitage story asset into play under any investigator's control. He does not take up an ally slot during this scenario. Put the set-aside Servant of Flame enemy into play at Miskatonic Quad. Place 3 [per_investigator] clues on Miskatonic Quad. The lead investigator must search the encounter deck and discard pile for 1 [per_investigator] copies of Fire! and draw them. (Shuffle the encounter deck if it was searched.)
flavor: Your friend had mentioned visiting the head librarian, Dr. Henry Armitage. With more and more strange figures arriving, you must scour the campus for his whereabouts.

name: Blaze of Glory
text: [fast] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Deal 1 [per_investigator] damage to an enemy at your location. [action]: Resign. You flee the burning campus. (This does not provoke attacks of opportunity.) Objective - If the Servant of Flame is defeated: Advance.
flavor: Your fiery nemesis can't be allowed to hurt more innocents! With Dr. Armitage's help, perhaps you can stop them.

name: Your Friend's Room
text: [action]: Engage. Choose an enemy at a connecting location. That enemy moves to this location and engages you. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
flavor: The dorm is quickly filling with smoke.

name: Servant of Flame
text: Hunter. Prey (lowest [agility]). Retaliate.

name: Dr. Henry Armitage
text:
You get +1 [willpower] and +1 [intellect].
The first action you perform each round does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
flavor: "I've seen more than my share of strange occurrences."

name: Miskatonic Quad
text: [fast] During your turn, if there are exactly 1 or 2 investigators in the game: Move to a connecting location. (Group limit once per round.)

name: Dormitories
text: [action]: Heal 1 damage and 1 horror. (Limit once per game.)
flavor: There's never a dull moment in the university dorms.

name: Science Hall
text: Forced - After you discover 1 or more clues at Science Hall: Choose and discard 1 card from your hand.
flavor: The students are never exactly sure what will be under the microscope each day.

name: Warren Observatory
text: [reaction] After you discover 1 or more clues at this location: Draw 1 card. (Limit once per round.)
flavor: To date, Miskatonic astronomers have identified at least 15 separate stars that appear to have gone missing from the Northern Hemisphere.

name: Orne Library
text: [action][action]: Draw 3 cards. (Limit once per game.)
flavor: Students have reported strange sounds coming from the empty archives at night...

name: Cantor of Flame
text: Retaliate.
flavor:
"By flame and blade, in shade and blood
Our queen reborn after the flood."
-Edict of Ash, Vol XIX

name: Hellhound
text: Hunter. Forced - After Hellhound attacks you during the enemy phase: Choose and discard 1 asset you control.

name: Bystander
text: Doomed. (When this enemy is defeated, place 1 doom on the current agenda. This effect can cause the current agenda to advance.)
flavor: They're always in the exact wrong place at the exact wrong time.

name: Cosmic Evils
text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Place 1 doom on the current agenda. This effect can cause the agenda to advance. - Take 1 direct damage and 1 direct horror. Cosmic Evils gains surge.

name: Unspeakable Truths
text: Revelation - Put Unspeakable Truths into play in your threat area. Limit 1 per investigator. Forced - After you discover 1 or more clues: Take 1 horror. [action][action]: Discard Unspeakable Truths.

name: Forbidden Secrets
text: Revelation - If you have no clues, Forbidden Secrets gains surge. Otherwise, test [intellect] (3). For each point you fail by, you must either place 1 of your clues on your location, or take 1 horror.
flavor: They say curiosity killed the cat. But will it kill you, too?

name: Extraplanar Visions
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] or [intellect] (X), where X is the number of cards in your hand. If you fail, take 1 damage and discard 1 card at random from your hand.

name: Wild Compulsion
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, you must either discard 1 card at random from your hand, or lose 1 resource.
flavor: "God help the dreamer whose mad visions shew Those did eyes set in crystal gulfs below!" -H.P. Lovecraft, "Fungi from Yuggoth"

name: Fire!
text: Revelation - Attach Fire! to the nearest location without Fire! attached. Forced - When the investigation phase ends: Each non-[[Elite]] card with health at this location takes 1 direct damage. [action]: Test [agility] (3). If you succeed, discard Fire!

name: Noxious Smoke
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] or [agility] (3). Take 1 damage for each point you fail by.
flavor: Where there's smoke, there's almost definitely fire.

name: Mutated!
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). This test gets +2 difficulty if there is an enemy at your location. If you fail, you must either take 2 damage, or each investigator at your location takes 1 horror.

name: Mutated Experiment
text: Forced - When this enemy is defeated: Each investigator at its location takes 1 horror.

name: Smoke and Mirrors
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull] -X. X is the total number of [[Elite]] enemies in the victory display and under the act.
[cultist] -1. If this is a test targeting an [[Elite]] enemy, reveal another token.
[tablet] -3. If you fail, place 1 of your clues on your location.
[elder_thing] -1 for each clue you control.
backText:
Hard / Expert
[skull] -X. X is 2 more than the total number of [[Elite]] enemies in the victory display and under the act.
[cultist] -3. If this is a test targeting an [[Elite]] enemy, reveal another token.
[tablet] -4. If you fail, place 1 of your clues on your location.
[elder_thing] -2 for each clue you control.

name: Arkham Alive
text: [action]: Resign. You return to compare notes with Dr. Armitage on your friend's whereabouts.
backText: One at a time, each investigator draws 1 copy of the set-aside Mark of Elokoss weakness. Each investigator is now the bearer of that weakness. (Add that card to that investigator's deck, ignoring deckbuilding restrictions. It does not count toward that investigator's deck size.)
flavor: An unnatural haze fills the streets of Arkham. Some of the locals say the hills west of Arkham are burning. Despite the cool autumn weather, the city streets feel unnaturally warm as evening falls.

name: Emergent Evils
text: [action]: Resign. You return to compare notes with Dr. Armitage on your friend's whereabouts.
backText: Each investigator immediately resigns.
flavor: Steam rises off of the wet pavement, as though the ground beneath it were actually burning.

name: Augurs of Flame
text: [action] Spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Draw the facedown card beneath your location. Objective - If there are a total of 6 [[Elite]] enemies in the victory display and/or under the act, advance. (Hint: Either defeat the suspects by force or resolve their codex entries to generate leads for your investigation!)
flavor: You must find the whereabouts of the suspects on your friend's list.

name: Mark of Elokoss
text: Revelation - Put Mark of Elokoss into play in your threat area. Forced - When your turn ends: Take 1 damage. Assign that damage to an asset you control, if able. [action][action]: Discard Mark of Elokoss.

name: Servant of Flame
text: Elusive. Hunter. Retaliate. Forced - When Servant of Flame is defeated: ([codex] Φ)

name: David Renfield
text: Aloof. (This enemy does not automatically engage investigators at its location.) [reaction] After you successfully investigate David Renfield's location: ([codex] 1).

name: Cornelia Akely
text: Alert. (After you fail a skill test while evading this enemy, it attacks you.) [reaction] After you successfully evade Cornelia Akely: Ready her. ([codex] 2).

name: Naomi O'Bannion
text: Retaliate. (After you fail a skill test while fighting this enemy, it attacks you.) [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] resources: Parley. ([codex] 3).

name: Sgt. Earl Monroe
text: Elusive. (After this enemy attacks or is attacked while it is ready, it moves to a connecting location with no investigators and exhausts.) [action]: Parley. Test [combat] (4). Decrease the difficulty for this test by 1 for each damage on Sgt. Earl Monroe. If you succeed, ([codex] 4).

name: Abigail Foreman
text: Aloof. (This enemy does not automatically engage investigators at its location.) [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (X), where X is the number of clues on Abigail Foreman's location. If you succeed, place 1 clue (from the token pool) on Abigail Foreman's location. ([codex] 5).

name: Margaret Liu
text: Aloof. (This enemy does not automatically engage investigators at its location.) [reaction] After you succeed at a skill test by 2 or more at Margaret Liu's location: ([codex] 6).

name: Downtown
text: [reaction] After you discover 1 or more clues at this location: Gain 1 resource.
flavor: It's fairly easy to take out a loan from the First Bank of Arkham, but don't forget to read the fine print...

name: Downtown
text: [reaction] After you discover 1 or more clues at this location: Heal 1 horror from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at this location.
flavor: Of course, nobody mentions the sanatorium.

name: Uptown
text: [action]: Heal up to 2 damage from among investigators and/or [[Ally]] assets at this location. (Limit once per game.)
flavor: Arkham's only hospital is flush with patients and put-upon nurses.

name: Uptown
text: [action]: Search the top 9 cards of your deck for a [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] asset and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck. If no card was added in this way, draw 1 card.
flavor:
"Come to Ye Olde Magick Shoppe to discover the wonders of REAL magic. Stage magicians will not be served."
-Local Advertisement

name: Northside
text: [action] Spend 5 resources: Discover 1 clue from any revealed [[Arkham]] location. (Limit once per round.)

name: Easttown
text: [reaction] After you discover the last clue from Easttown: Search your deck for an [[Ally]] asset and play it (paying its cost). Shuffle your deck. (Limit once per game.)

name: Merchant District
text: [fast] During your turn, if there are exactly 1 or 2 investigators in the game: Move to a connecting location. (Limit once per round.)

name: Waterfront District
text: As an additional cost to investigate Waterfront District, you must spend 1 action.
flavor: Anyone who doesn't want to walk in waist-high water needs to hitch a ride from one of the locals.

name: Southside
text: [action][action]: Investigators at this location draw a combined total of 3 cards, divided as they choose. (Group limit once per round.)

name: French Hill
text: [action] Choose and discard 1 card from your hand: Place 1 charge or secret on an asset you control. (Limit once per round.)

name: Miskatonic University
text: Forced - When the investigation phase ends: Deal 1 direct damage to each player card with health at Miskatonic University.

name: Miskatonic University
text: [action]: Play a [[Tome]] or [[Spell]] asset from your discard pile, reducing its cost by 2. (Limit once per game.)

name: Arcane Lock
text: Revelation - Attach Arcane Lock to your location. Limit 1 per location. As an additional cost to enter or leave attached location, you must spend 1 action. [action]: Test [willpower] or [intellect] (4). If you succeed, discard Arcane Lock.

name: Downpour
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). For each point you fail by, you must either lose 1 action or place 1 of your clues on your location.
flavor: "... there descended such a blinding sheet of torrential rain that shelter became imperative." -H.P. Lovecraft, "The Lurking Fear"

name: Flash Flood
text: Revelation - Attach Flash Flood to your location. Attached location gets +4 shroud. Forced - When the round ends: Discard Flash Flood.

name: Raising Suspicions
text: Revelation - Place 1 doom on the nearest enemy with no doom on it. If no doom was placed by this effect, Raising Suspicions gains surge.
flavor: At least you tried to keep a low profile.

name: Red Herring
text: Revelation - Test [intellect] (2). This test gets +2 difficulty if you control 2 or more clues. If you fail, take 1 horror and place 1 of your clues on your location.

name: Bat Horror
text: Elusive. Hunter.
flavor: "...there flopped rhythmically a horde of tame, trained, hybrid winged things that no sound eye could ever wholly grasp, or sound brain ever wholly remember." -H.P. Lovecraft, "The Festival"

name: Aerial Pursuit
text: Surge. Revelation - The nearest non-[[Elite]] enemy moves once toward your location. If it engages an investigator, it makes an immediate attack.

name: Rogue Gangster
text: Hunter. Prey (most resources). Retaliate. Forced - After Rogue Gangster engages you: Lose 1 resource. If you cannot, this enemy attacks you.

name: Crossfire
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). If you fail, each investigator at your location takes 1 damage.
flavor: "Get down!"

name: Whippoorwill
text:
Aloof. Hunter.
Each investigator at Whippoorwill's location gets -1 [willpower], -1 [intellect], -1 [combat], and -1 [agility].
flavor: "It is vowed that the birds are psychopomps lying in wait for the souls of the dying..." -H.P. Lovecraft, "The Dunwich Horror"

name: Eager for Death
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). Increase this skill test's difficulty by 1 for each damage on you. If you fail, take 2 horror.
flavor: "If they can catch the fleeing soul when it leaves the body, they instantly flutter away chittering in daemonic laughter." -H.P. Lovecraft, "The Dunwich Horror"

name: Queen of Ash
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull] -X. X is the number of Fire! treacheries in play.
[cultist] -2. If this is an attack or evasion targeting a [[Cultist]] enemy, reveal another token.
[tablet] -2 (-4 instead if you are at a [[Ritual Site]] location).
[elder_thing] -3. If you fail, draw the topmost copy of Fire! in the encounter discard pile.
backText:
Hard / Expert
[skull] -X. X is twice the number of Fire! treacheries in play.
[cultist] -3. If this is an attack or evasion targeting a [[Cultist]] enemy, reveal another token.
[tablet] -4. If you are at a [[Ritual Site]] location, you automatically fail instead.
[elder_thing] -5. If you fail, draw the topmost copy of Fire! in the encounter discard pile.

name: A Gathering
text: Each enemy at a location with a copy of Fire! attached cannot be damaged.
backText:
If the Servant of Flame enemy is set aside, spawn it at Underground Cistern.
Each investigator must test [willpower] (4). Each investigator who fails takes 1 direct horror.
flavor: Chanting echoes through the fetid tunnels. The cult's rebirth is at hand!

name: A Ritual
text: Each enemy at a location with a copy of Fire! attached cannot be damaged.
backText:
If it is act 1:
Hungry flames spread through the tunnels, and the chants below intensify. You were too late to stop the summoning.
Reveal Underground Cistern and spawn Elokoss at it, (Mother of Flame) side faceup. Replace the current act and agenda with special agenda 3a: Brethren of Ash. It is both the current act and the current agenda.
Otherwise:
The ancient queen of ash awakens with a horrific wail.
Flip Elokoss to her (Mother of Flame) side, keeping all damage and attachments on her. Replace the current act and agenda with special agenda 3a: Brethren of Ash. It is both the current act and the current agenda.
flavor: The air is choked with noxious smoke as the sounds of chanting grow louder.

name: Brethren of Ash
text: Forced - When doom would be placed on a card: Each investigator takes 1 direct damage, instead. Forced - If each remaining investigator is defeated: Advance. Objective - If Elokoss is defeated, (→R1) (page 13).
backText: Each investigator is killed.

name: Search the Sewers
text: Objective - When an investigator enters Underground Cistern, advance.
backText: Spawn the set-aside Elokoss enemy at Underground Cistern, (Faint Embers) side faceup. The investigator at Underground Cistern draws one of the set-aside Fire! treacheries. Shuffle each other copy of Fire! into the encounter deck, along with the set-aside Queen's Knight and Herald of Flame enemies. Put the set-aside Sluice Control location into play.
flavor: The Brethren of Ash could be anywhere. You must search the sewers for the cult's ritual site if you hope to save your friend.

name: Stop the Rite
text: [fast] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Discard a copy of Fire! at your location. Forced - When the round ends: Each [[Cultist]] enemy moves once toward Underground Cistern. Objective - If Elokoss is defeated, advance.
flavor: You must stop the rite at any cost. You could scour the cistern for a means to stop the cult, or you could try to chop their profane idol to tinder!

name: Underground Cistern
text: Forced - If there are no clues on Underground Cistern: Place clues (from the token pool) on it up to its clue value. Forced - When the investigation phase ends: Discard each ready non-[[Elite]] [[Cultist]] enemy at this location. Place 1 doom on the agenda for each enemy discarded in this way.
backText: As an additional cost to enter Underground Cistern, investigators must spend 3 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.

name: Sluice Control
text: [action]: "Stop them at all costs!" You try to open the sluice valve. Test [agility] or [combat] (5). If you succeed, each enemy is defeated and each investigator who has not resigned is killed (→R3) (page 14)
backText: As an additional cost to enter Sluice Control, investigators must spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
flavor: There's no better time to be a hero.

name: Ashen Rebirth
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (4). If you fail, you must either take 2 direct damage or 2 direct horror (whichever you have more of).
flavor:
"And so shall ye be remade: a burnt offering to her glory and a symbol of the ecstasy that awaits us all."
- Edict of Ash, Vol III

name: Queen's Knight
text: Hunter. Forced - When Queen's Knight takes 1 or more damage: Deal 1 damage to Elokoss.

name: Herald of Flame
text: Hunter. Forced - After this enemy attacks: Heal 1 damage from each enemy at its location.

name: Elokoss
text: Massive. Retaliate. Elokoss gets +5 [per_investigator] health, cannot move, and cannot make attacks of opportunity. [fast] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues: Place 1 clue on Elokoss. If Elokoss has 5 clues on her, (→R2) (page 14).

name: Elokoss
text: Hunter. Massive. Retaliate. Elokoss gets +5 [per_investigator] health. Forced - After you evade Elokoss: Ready her. She cannot attack you for the remainder of the round.

name: Servant of Flame
text: Hunter. Retaliate. Forced - When Servant of Flame is defeated: ([codex] Φ)

name: Collector
text:
Permanent. Reward. Limit 1 per deck. Purchase only at deck creation.
You get +5 deck size.
Your investigator's Deckbuilding Options gains: "one other [[Relic]] or [[Charm]] asset of any class ([guardian], [seeker], [rogue], [mystic], [survivor]) level 0-3."

name: Sewer Culvert
text: Sewer Culvert is connected to each Sewer Tunnels location, and vice versa. [action]: Resign. "I can't take it any more!" You flee the sewers.
backText: Sewer Culvert is connected to each Sewer Tunnels location, and vice versa.

name: Sewer Tunnels
text: Forced - After you enter this location: Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until an enemy is discarded and draw it.
flavor: Whatever is here is worse than rats.

name: Sewer Tunnels
text: Forced - After you enter this location: Lose 1 action.
flavor: Gnarled roots have reclaimed the network of tunnels, making them difficult to navigate.

name: Sewer Tunnels
text: Forced - When you end your turn at this location: Take 1 horror.
flavor: Whatever tore through the wall sure wasn't trying to get into the crypt.

name: Sewer Tunnels
text: [reaction] When you end your turn at this location: Gain 1 resource.
flavor: Judging by the quality of the hooch and contraband, this stash was put here by the Sheldon gang. You can help yourself, so long as they don't find out.

name: Sewer Tunnels
text: Forced - When you end your turn at this location: Choose and discard 1 card from your hand.
flavor: What is that floating just beneath the surface?

name: Zealot
text: Aloof. Forced - After this enemy enters play: Place 1 doom on it.

name: Dark Magician
text: Hunter. Retaliate. Forced - When the round ends: Place 1 doom on the enemy with no doom on it nearest to Dark Magician.

name: Blasphemous Invocation
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, place 1 doom on a [[Cultist]] enemy with no doom on it. If you fail and no doom was placed, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Cultist]] enemy and draw it. (Shuffle the encounter deck if it was searched.)

name: Unnatural Decay
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (4). If you fail, you must either place 1 doom on an asset you control, or take 2 damage.
flavor: You've never seen something rust so quickly.

name: Putrid Vapors
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). If you fail, take 1 horror and discard a non-story asset you control.
flavor: "The removal of the slab revealed a black aperture, from which rushed an effluence of miasmal gases so nauseous that we started back in horror." -H.P. Lovecraft, "The Statement of Randolph Carter"

name: Langour
text: Revelation - Put Languor into play in your threat area. Limit 1 per investigator. Forced - After your turn begins: Discard the top card of your deck. If it is a weakness, draw it. Otherwise, you cannot play or commit cards of that type (asset, event, or skill) this round. [action][action]: Discard Languor.

name: Dissonance
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, lose 1 action and choose a cardtype (asset, event, or skill). Discard all non-weakness cards of the chosen type from your hand.

name: Torment
text: Peril. Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, name a cardtype (asset, event, or skill). Each investigator discards 1 card of the named type from their hand.
